**Event:** 21st Conference of the European Association of Work and Organizational Psychology\
**Location:** Katowice, Poland\
**Authors:** Bakaç, C., Kehr, H. M., & Lang, J. W. B.\
**Symposium:** Predicting leadership, negotiation, aggression, and faking with implicit measures
(Chairs: M. Runge & J. W. B. Lang)

## Context

Presented evidence that implicit and explicit motives contribute differently to negotiation
outcomes, and that treating them as interchangeable predictors obscures both effects.
